description:
Submit a contact enrichment job for one or more email addresses or LinkedIn profile URLs.
Provide emails, linkedInUrls, or both.
Set phoneValidation to true to also confirm each phone number with a live phone call; it raises the price per contact from $0.02 to $0.19.
If logged in, the job is charged to the account's YourICP billing-token balance (2 billing tokens per contact matched, 19 with phoneValidation, where 100 billing tokens = $1.00) and returns a jobId — call check_lookup to retrieve results. check_billing_balance shows what the balance covers.
If the balance is short, this returns error "mcp_insufficient_tokens" with required, available and shortfall counts — tell the user exactly how many tokens to top up at app.youricp.com and do NOT retry until they have. If it returns "mcp_no_billing_account", only support can fix it — do NOT retry.
If the user is not logged in, card payment is required instead ($0.02 per contact, $0.19 with phoneValidation): this tool returns a checkoutUrl and sessionId — present the URL, then call check_payment. Card payments start at $0.50; below that it returns error "below_card_minimum" — suggest signing in instead.
Do NOT retry automatically on failure.

emails.description: List of email addresses to look up

linkedInUrls.description: List of LinkedIn profile URLs to look up

phoneValidation.description: Also confirm each phone number with a live phone call. Raises the price per contact from $0.02 to $0.19 (2 to 19 billing tokens).

userEmail.description: Email address of the user requesting the lookup (used for payment receipt when payment is required)

name: submit_lookup
